On completed returns the triage shows only candidate-unknowns (dependent.multiple_support read unasked), which mask value witnesses. Ruled on the expression, as in the Landing round.

Triage .transcription/triage/2025/dependent.json (log sha matches): 2,748/6,501 agree; 2,496 candidate-unknown, 1,163 value, 85 candidate-refuses, 6 project-unknown, 3 project-refuses; completed: 174 value, 24 candidate-unknown. Every value witness sampled is either f2441.care false (the project evaluates the qualifying-person test only with care expenses) or, for dc_count, the project's per-dependent 1 that its reader filters by dc_qp. Those are representation. The line is ruled on its expression: the qualifying-child path is claimed AND h_qc AND under 13, and h_qc has no part-year rule (p503 p. 3, "a person who was born or died in 2025 is treated as having lived with you for more than half of 2025 if your home was the person's home more than half the time they were alive"). The embedded dependent test carries the joint-return exemption (see dependent.claimed). The incapable-person path now uses a part-year rule (hoh_test2_lived), so the Landing-round witness stage15.f2441.parent_died_part_year no longer differs.
